I am an Assistant Research Professor and the Program Manager of the Data Science program in the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science at Rutgers University–Newark. My research investigates visual perception, with a primary focus on spatial vision. I emphasize computational and data-driven approaches in my work, utilizing R, Python, and MATLAB for statistical modeling, data visualization, and processing complex neuroimaging and behavioral datasets. Prior to my current roles, I earned my PhD in Psychology from Concordia University and completed postdoctoral fellowships at the University of York and Rutgers Univeristy - Newark.
